unsupported_schema_version.description: A present string schema version is not supported.

invalid_request.description: Malformed query, header, path or request framing.

invalid_cursor.description: Cursor is invalid, expired or incompatible with this authorized query.

unauthenticated.description: Caller authentication is absent or invalid.

forbidden.description: Caller lacks permission for the operation.

not_found.description: Resource does not exist or is not visible to this caller.

idempotency_conflict.description: The scoped idempotency key has conflicting input.

invalid_state_transition.description: Requested transition conflicts with current state.

result_pending.description: The task has no available terminal result yet.

remote_outcome_unknown.description: Remote acceptance or outcome cannot be established.

unsupported_media_type.description: The request media type is unsupported.

validation_failed.description: The parsed supported-version payload violates its schema.

unsupported_capability.description: The selected agent cannot perform the requested operation.

cancellation_unsupported.description: The owner does not support remote cancellation.

content_unavailable.description: Authorized source content could not be obtained.

rate_limited.description: The caller has exceeded a rate limit.

internal_error.description: Unexpected local failure; details are withheld.

auth_failed.description: Destination authentication failed; caller credentials are not implicated.

unavailable.description: A required service or eligible agent is unavailable.

request_in_progress.description: An authorized request with this key and fingerprint has an unresolved local reservation. No new work is created.
